additional_info.subject: RE: ID0403700-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727012] Charger on Power_save mode CRM:00579001462
additional_info.body:
Dear Joao, good morning.
I conclude our meeting after resolving the charging station problem.
After checking the continuity of the communication cables, it was found that the continuity was correct.
We then replaced the EcoG KF11 and then the charging station returned to work.
In addition, a microswitch was replaced in the rear charging station door.
Br,
Orel.

additional_info.subject: 0403700 - ID0403700-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727012] Charger on Power_save mode CRM:00472000265
additional_info.body:
Hello Orel,
Brief report from our activities in last intervention since from the ticket the information is missing.
Charger was not in Power saving mode, the benders were displaying deactivated. This was reported to R&D since looks a miss information from the actual state (Lost Communication).
We have check all wire connections and there was no issue. But the flag remains. We decided then replace KF11 that is the device responsible for the communication with the benders.
After the replacement the charger was back in operation.
During the activity we detect that the door switch from the back was broken. A request was made for replacement. According your feedback is already replaced.
Thank you for your efforts and cooperation.
We will proceed to close this ticket.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
